desc:
🧪 RoRealism – the most realistic ragdoll sandbox on Roblox!

Test every weapon on crash test dummies and watch real physics take over. Dummies stumble, limp, fall over and get back up… or don't.

💥 20+ WEAPONS
Handgun, shotgun, rifle, sniper, rocket launcher, grenades, TNT, a NUKE, knives, swords, spears, arrows, darts, freeze ray, taser and more.

🩺 DOCTOR MODE
See every dummy's injuries, heart rate and oxygen live.

🎢 TEST STATIONS
Spinner, wrecking ball, sweepers, trampoline, pool, brick wall and the TEST ZONE booth.

🥊 NPCs FIGHT BACK
Turn it on in Settings and the dummies raise their fists!

🛠️ SANDBOX PASS
Spawn and drag dummies, freeze time, slow motion and a free camera.

🏆 Climb the kills and playtime leaderboards.

📱💻🎮 Play on phone, tablet, PC and console!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

Tags: ragdoll, physics, sandbox, realistic, crash test dummy, weapons, guns, sniper, nuke, explosions, simulator
